text: Molson Coors Beverage Company is a NYSE-listed brewer with no state ownership; voting control rests with the Coors and Molson families via a voting trust (Pentland Securities/Coors Trust, 96.2% of Class A voting stock), while Vanguard (12.0%) and Dodge & Cox (10.2%) are the largest holders of the non-voting Class B float.

source.name: Molson Coors DEF 14A 2026
source.quote: The Coors Trust, Pentland and 4280661 Canada Inc. (Pentland's subsidiary) are parties to voting trust arrangements combining their voting power over the Class A common stock
